WELLS FARGO
Intern Analyst - Summer Internship
Name : Misha Azmi
Third Year - Information Technology
Location : Hyderabad or Bangalore
Stipend : 90,000 INR

Round 1 : Coding Test - 8th August, 2022
Divided into 3 sections
Verbal Aptitude : First section had 10 questions
●
Fill in the blanks with appropriate words
●
Basic grammar questions
●
Questions based on the given passage
Business Aptitude : Second section had 10 questions
●
Questions on graph analysis
Coding Section : Third section had 2 coding questions
Since this test was taken a month before the interview, I don’t remember the questions.
The only thing I remember is that we had 45 mins to complete. The questions asked were long
but on understanding it was easy to implement.
2

Online Interview - 7th September, 2022
Technical Interview (40 mins)
8 students were selected for this round
Questions asked :
●
Tell me about yourself
●
Explain your project. Follow up questions were asked on the project like technology
used, purpose of the project, target audience.
HTML & CSS
●
Since the project I had mentioned was mainly front-end based, questions on HTML were
asked in depth.
●
Difference between elements and tag
●
What is <i>, <en>? Difference between them.
●
What is a void tag? Give examples
●
Basic questions were asked on CSS and regarding its implementation in my project
OS
●
What is OS?
●
Different types of OS
●
Which OS is used in College?
●
Other basic OS regarding questions were asked
DBMS
●
Types of keys
●
Difference between primary key and unique key
●
Delete, truncate, drop
●
What is rollback operation? Rollback operation after delete, truncate, drop
3

Algorithm Analysis
●
Started with what is algorithm analysis, why it is important and where it is used in real
life.
DSA
●
Types of data structure, where they are used
●
I was asked to explain Stack
●
All the following questions were based on Stack and its implementation
General Question
●
How does Wells Fargo work?
Technical + HR (only HR for me)
●
Introduce yourself
●
Favourite subject. Why?
●
Hobbies
●
Family background
●
How will I make a difference at Wells Fargo?
●
Was asked to elaborate the extracurricular work mention on the resume
After this round 4 students were offered the internship
Tips
●
Know your resume well. Questions were asked on every part of the resume
●
Research about the company well. Their head (CEO). How does the company work
●
For HTML : https://www.interviewbit.com/html-interview-questions/
●
For OS : https://www.interviewbit.com/operating-system-interview-questions/
●
For DBMS : https://www.interviewbit.com/dbms-interview-questions/
●
For OOPS : https://www.interviewbit.com/oops-interview-questions/
4
